title: Launching my second otome visual novel next month
author: imjjang
selftext: I have always wanted to create otome visual novels but was never able to....with AI I am finally able to having help in the areas I am not skilled in (coding and graphics) and I can't wait for my second game on itch.io!

comments.author: Spare-Connection-286
comments.body:
THIS LOOKS GREAT!!! 

how did you make the pictures btw, I’m a newer AI artist and would love to make art like yours

replies.author: imjjang
replies.body:
🤧🥺🥹 thank you so much!!!!

For my first game I used Canva AI for the backgrounds (for free and ran out of credits) and free chat GPT on different accounts for everything else which was so annoying because I had to use multiple accounts to make everything I needed so for the second game I got Plus. 

Basically I would ask Claude who was helping with my game development to help me come up with a prompt and 9 times out of 10 it was perfect. I would give Chat the character pictures again plus the background image for reference and it was pretty good. 

THAT SAID I am new too this has been literally my first attempt if you ignore any small actual corporate AI work so I am not sure if this is ideal but I learned a lot from the first game to the second. Continuing to feed it the reference pictures and having another tool create the prompt is a great way to make sure you give it all of the details so it doesnt go astray. Sometimes you have to try and try and try 5 times until it gets it good or consistent with the rest but that is generally my work flow 🤧🤧 I hope this helps.

replies.author: Spare-Connection-286
replies.body:
I’m working on a romance novel too, ironic I know!

it’s about the player (a human) accidentally stumbling upon a ‘herd’ of non human creatures, and now the Player is stuck with these non human creatures

i’m trying to make it very personalized, so basically the player can choose their appearance, give info about themselves (especially their sexuality, you’ll know why soon) then they’ll have a character sheet for themselves and they can change it and tweak it, and if they say they’re like lesbian then all the characters will be females, if they say they’re gay then all the characters will be males, if they say they’re like bisexual then it’ll be a mix of females and males, if they have a preference then they can choose what genders they want the romancables to be, they can also do things like lesbian (but straight ficto), gay (but straight ficto), etc, aka they’re lesbian/gay/etc irl but are straight whenever it comes to FICTIONAL characters

replies.author: imjjang
replies.body: Ohhhhh I wanted to do a personalized MC at one point but that sounds really really interesting! I think that will be really popular because you can literally imagine your player exactly as you want / are irl!!

replies.body: i probably won’t make it a official game since I haven’t for 8 years but it’s still a good idea
